notes.title: Update V1.14 Steam Deck, fixes, and enemy stats in inventory!
notes.notes:
Hi, this update has improvements for Steam Deck and Steam Cloud. Also you can now click on an enemy button in the inventory screen during duels to view their stats! Plus more fixes and improvements. Enjoy!

- Steam Deck: Replaced "Click" in all tutorial text with "Tap".
- Steam Deck: If "Exit Game" is used via the Steam button the game will no longer say "Sorry the game didn't close properly last time." on next boot.
- Steam Deck: The on-screen keyboard will now appear automatically when the player is promted to enter their name.
- Steam Deck: Replaced "Click to continue" on the first story dialog with "Tap to continue" and made it larger.
- Improved Steam Cloud support so that the first time you play on another device it will pick the first profile in the profile list instead of using a blank profile.
- Updated steam_api.dll and Steamstub.dll
- You can now pass in command line arguments (Steam Launch Options) to change the save data location as follows: SaveInDocuments or SaveInAppData or SaveInCGames or SaveInExeFolder
- Fixed a typo in family heirloom's lore.
- Fixed Gold Multiplier tooltip showing in Duel Mode when there is no multiplier UI.
- Fixed an issue when rapidly clicking the stock pile and obtaining a wildcard.
- Fixed an issue with completed multiplier goals being reverted if retrying hand 1 in a chapter.
- Fixed Rainy Day Fund achievement so it triggers >=50000 instead of >50000.
- Fixed Chapter 16 and Chapter 22 boss goals being marked as completed too early.
- Defringed all menu buttons and similar UI elements.
- Sped up UI fade out on Select Chapter screen when you choose a chapter.
- Fixed a visual glitch with the player's character card when exiting the game screen.
- Prevented a double volume click from happening when you use an Active Ability card.
- Prevented player or enemy from being able to stunlock the other.
- In Very Hard mode you will be warned if you didn't get a 3 stars and clicked Next in case it was accidental.
- Fixed an issue with Very Hard mode on Chapter 5 where the scoreboard started with a negative number.
* New Feature! Added an "enemy" button to the inventory screen during fights. It shows the enemy stats to help you decide what to equip.

notes.title: Regency Solitaire II Multi-Language Update!
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33035039/e7f0487fc5cbd3a045c7d50f6b0faab1798668ed.png[/img]

You can now [b]change language[/b] for Regency Solitaire II on Steam via the options screen.

Supported languages are: English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, and Brazilian Portuguese.

Note: at present we have no plans to officially support more languages because we are an indie microstudio. But we welcome fan translations.

Enjoy playing Regency Solitaire II in your chosen language!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2137470/Regency_Solitaire_II/

notes.title: V1.13 Update
notes.notes:
- Clicking Newsletter and More Games no longer closes the game to open the browser unless you are in full screen mode.
- Fixed an issue where running the game for the first time would show a dialog saying "Starting in Windowed mode due to incorrect shutdown."
- If the game is closed incorrectly (e.g. from a crash) it will now show a dialog on boot that allows the player to try out an OpenGL graphics driver instead of DirectX, which may work better on some Intel video cards.
- Fixed OpenGL windowed mode so it has a title bar.
- If the game fails to save data it now shows an error message advising players to exclude/whitelist the game/save data folder in their virus killer or One Drive.
- Changed Regency Solitaire II references to "Out Now".

notes.title: V1.12 update
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug with Deflect Animals not stacking if you wore the Teal Coak and the Ermine Cowl. It stacks properly now.
- Defringed the images in the Graphics/News folder.

notes.title: V1.11 Update
notes.notes:
V1.10:
- Fixed bug when using Branding Iron on mask card. It now reduces suit locks by 2 instead of 1.
- Removed LoadingScreenWithLogo.jpg as it was not being used. Reduces game size by 1Mb.
V1.11:
- Prevented name entry with non-latin characters (e.g Russian) as it causes a problem with the save data.
- Made sure that Skip Story button is always in the default state even if it was clicked before.
- Deleted shop item mouse over image from data\graphics\ShopScreen and from Loading code.
- Fixed bonus stock cards only being created with suits in range 0-3 instead of 0-5. No effect on gameplay, just visuals.
- Fixed tooltip order so that if a key is in a suit lock the tooltip is about the suit lock not the key.
- Stars are now correctly aligned when they stop flying onto the screen.
- Tweaked level 21-1 layout a bit and gave two normal cards dark card backs. Doesn't affect gameplay.
- Removed two unused test levels.
- Added Ancient Enemy to More Games dialog.
- Added News Dialog and Icon for Regency Solitaire II Steam page.
- Updated default.ini version number to 1.11
- Other minor code enhancements.

Note: These updates only apply to the PC version.

notes.title: V1.09 minor update released. Shuffle fix in duels.
notes.notes:
This is just a minor update to fix rare issues that users have told us about.

Fixes:
- Prevented shuffle ability in duels from moving spare cards/jokers into the stock pile as this could cause issues.
- Disabled the log file as one user reported an error writing to it.

notes.title: V1.08 update released! Inventory and other improvements.
notes.notes:
Improvements:
- Added tooltips for difficulty mode checkboxes on the Select Chapter screen.
- Mousing over an outfit slot now glows corresponding outfit cards in the player's inventory.
- Modified outfit sorting in inventory screen so that jackets appears earlier to better correspond with outfit slot order.
- The tip which tells players to mouse over the enemy to see their stats is now also shown on hand 4-3 and hand 6-1 to make sure they have seen it.
- The Goals Not Met dialog retry button now says "Retry Chapter" to make it ultra clear.
- The Goal Not Met dialog (for when you miss a story item) retry button now says "Retry Hand" to make it ultra clear.
- A dialog is no longer shown if you just picked up a story item that you already picked up earlier in a chapter e.g. Wanted Posters

Fixes:
- Disabled Family Jewels and Heirloom Brooch on the first tutorial level in case they mess up the fixed stock.

notes.title: V1.07 update released! Lots of little improvements.
notes.notes:
Improvements:
- Tool weapons now say "(Tool)" on the large version of the collectible card.
- Sea/Land weapons now say "(Sea)" or "(Land)" on the large version of the collectible card.
- Added a newsletter button to the Title Screen.
- Tweaked Stand and Deliver ability to generate a playable card more often.
- Tweaked Shadowhand shuffle ability to reveal playable cards more often.
- Ability cards now fill from the bottom of the screen as they charge, not from the bottom of the card which is off the screen.
- Profile system now records and restores backups if need be.
- Game will reload in Windowed mode after a crash.
- Deleted unused graphics from Menus folder
- Compressed ambientsounds folder from 64Mb to 7Mb by using oggs thus reducing install size.

Fixes:
- Prevented wildcards/jokers from being used on the first tutorial level.

notes.title: V1.06 update released! Sell items and view stars earned per chapter.
notes.notes:
Improvements:
- You can now sell items back to the shop! Simply drag the item you want to sell over the shop area. You'll only get 10% of the full item price though because the main purpose of this is for people who want to tidy up their inventories.
- Stars earned are shown above the chapter cards on the Select Chapter screen. Each mode (relaxed/normal/very hard) records stars earned separately.
- Added confirmation dialog for when purchasing shop items.
- Default.ini changed so that game will load in borderless window instead of full-screen on first play.

Fixes:
- Fixed Borderless Window on Mac to have no title bar and to hide app launcher bar.
- Fixed desktop icon on Mac so that it's no longer the default Steam icon.
- Fixed "I admit am" typo in Ch9 story.

notes.title: Shadowhand, the solitaire RPG, finally has a release date
notes.notes:
How can you not be desperate to play this: a game which blends the casual satisfaction of clicking cards away in a game of solitaire with a tactical turn-based RPG and a story about an 18th-century highwaywoman. Oh, and it's by the developers of the wonderful Jane Austen-themed puzzle game, Regency Solitaire.

The game is Shadowhand, it finally has a release date, and it's blessedly soon: 7th December. It will launch on that date for Windows and Mac on Steam, GOG, the Humble Store and direct from the publisher Positech.

If you're wondering why I sound so excited: well, I'm a solitaire obsessive and collector of its weird video game variants, and this sounds like the spiciest solitaire mash-up since Pocket Card Jockey on 3DS blended the card game with a surprisingly high-energy take on horse-racing. As such, I've been following Shadowhand for a what feels like a long time. I saw a convincing demo early last year and at that point we were expecting it last summer. Earlier this week, I asked the designer and programmer Jake Birkett what had taken so long over email and he said, "I should have known that combining a turn-based RPG with solitaire would take ages!"
